titel: Golf around Venray: two courses close by | Hotel Asteria
omschrijving: Golf around Hotel Asteria in Venray: Golfclub Geijsteren a quarter of an hour away and Golfbaan Landgoed Bleijenbeek. With a golf package including an 18-hole green fee.
hero-sub: A woodland course on a historic estate and a rolling course by a castle ruin, both close to the hotel.
hero-alt: A golfer teeing off on a sunny fairway, with a golf bag in the foreground
intro-tekst: Golfclub Geijsteren is a quarter of an hour away and Golfbaan Landgoed Bleijenbeek in Afferden about 25 minutes. Play your round, come back for the sauna and take a seat in the brasserie. The golf package includes the green fee for 18 holes.
p2-regel: A quarter of an hour to 25 minutes' drive.

_vergelijk.sub: The two courses side by side.

waarden.Golfclub Geijsteren: 13 holes among the trees, then 5 water holes
waarden.Golfbaan Landgoed Bleijenbeek: Water features, avenues of trees and a castle ruin

arr-sub: A green fee for 18 holes at Geijsteren or Bleijenbeek, a three-course dinner, a night in a Royale room and the breakfast buffet. You'll see the price for your dates when you book.
dag-sub: From the first tee to dinner.
m1-tekst: A hearty breakfast, then a quarter of an hour's drive to Geijsteren.
m1-alt: A basket of fresh bread rolls on the breakfast buffet at Hotel Asteria
m2-tekst: First among the trees, then the water holes. Take time for a drink in the clubhouse.

f1-v: Which courses are near the hotel?
f1-a: Golfclub Geijsteren, about a quarter of an hour's drive, and Golfbaan Landgoed Bleijenbeek in Afferden, about 25 minutes.
f2-v: What's included in the golf package?
f2-a: A green fee for 18 holes at Geijsteren or Bleijenbeek, a three-course dinner, a night in a Royale room and the breakfast buffet.
f3-v: How do I book the golf package?
f3-a: With the Book the package button on this page. The code GOLF is filled in automatically.
f4-v: Do I need to book a tee time myself?
f4-a: Ask when you book or at reception how tee times are arranged; it differs per course.
f5-a: If you like woodland with water at the end, choose Geijsteren. If you're after rolling terrain, water features and a castle ruin, Bleijenbeek is for you.
f6-v: Can I book just a room?
f6-a: Yes, the booking button at the top books a room without a package. You then arrange the green fee with the course yourself.
meer-sub: A day without golf? There's plenty to do around Venray.
slot-kop: After your round, back to your room
slot-tekst: Book the golf package or a room, and play the other course tomorrow.
slot-alt: A fairway at Golfbaan Landgoed Bleijenbeek with the clubhouse in the background

Golfclub Geijsteren.tekst: An atmospheric, wooded course on a historic estate. The first 13 holes are tucked away among the trees, followed by 5 challenging water holes. A course with character.

Golfbaan Landgoed Bleijenbeek.tekst: Set in the unspoilt Maasduinen area of Limburg. This rolling course with water features, old avenues of trees and a castle ruin calls for tactical play thanks to its clever layout and changes in height.
